known_patches: Neutral namespace; original tool names/count/order retained
Integer input identities and consistent existing seed identity references
Existing source persona credentials only; all source guards retained
Page.id is the source textual wiki business key; preserve its text argument instead of applying opaque-ID integer normalization.
limitations: Only PluginConfig.enabled stored flags and native Page.content readback certified; no plugin activation, disk writes, git/history/rendering/media or remote XML-RPC effects executed.

Original source plugin guard is superuser-config OR addressed-plugin-exists; signed-in nonadmin may pass the second alternative. Exact source gap and observed peer outcomes are preserved, not replaced with an invented conjunction.

Page.id and plugin text business keys preserved; integer id is only an internal alias for PluginConfig predicate targeting. Native password argument pass is retained via original dklib callable support.

Original sign_in parameter user/login maps to its existing account username column, but source runtime only reads username or that column name. Add optional username input alias equal to the real parameter; existing credentials, account rows, tools and password/ACL comparisons stay unchanged. No credential column or authentication implementation is added.
